_note: Fine-tuning settings per hyperparameter group, set to the defaults of the official ETH-XGaze training code (config.py / trainer.py: Adam, lr 1e-4, batch 50, 25 epochs, StepLR every 10 epochs x 0.1, L1 loss, BatchNorm in train mode), plus early stopping: training stops after 3 epochs without improvement of the validation error and keeps the best weights. Validation: a held-out training session (personalization) or user (domain); for calibration, 2 of the 9 calibration targets, then a refit on all 9 targets for the selected number of epochs. Fix them before any test task is scored; every scenario of a group uses the same settings.
